description: The v2 generator creates synthetic files with fixed timestamps. DOCX fixtures start as hand-written OOXML, are opened and saved by BetterOffice, and carry paragraph ids. The manifest pins each published file by size and SHA-256. Downloads and local fixtures are verified against those pins.
Regenerated bytes can change when engine output changes. A changed fixture set needs a new version prefix and updated pins. Fixed timestamps do not guarantee identical bytes across engine versions.

limits: The v2 results cover small synthetic fixtures, one run per task and one model. They measure the agent and tools together. They do not establish performance on real-world documents, other models or repeated runs. The checkers validate defined edits rather than visual rendering quality.
Tool counts differ by arm. Timings cannot support a speed comparison across arms. Wilson intervals do not account for task selection or predict results on other document sets.
reproduce:
for p in fonts docx xlsx pptx agents; do bun run --filter "@betteroffice/$p" build; done
eval/formats/run.sh "node packages/agents/dist/cli.js" /tmp/format-eval gpt-6-luna

python3 eval/formats/check.py xlsx-04-style-header /tmp/format-eval/xlsx-04-style-header/output.xlsx
python3 eval/formats/validate-checkers.py
python3 eval/formats/test-runner.py
bun eval/formats/generate-fixtures.ts /tmp/format-fixtures

arms.label: Generic file tools
arms.summary: Shell and Python with python-docx, openpyxl and python-pptx, without network access.
details: The agent uses shell commands and Python with python-docx, openpyxl and python-pptx in a workspace-write sandbox, with no network or MCP servers. Logged commands are audited for access to the repository or task metadata. Reads are not isolated by the filesystem sandbox.
arms.tool_calls: Shell commands and file edits; one command can run a whole script.

arms.label: BetterOffice MCP
arms.summary: Only the BetterOffice MCP server for document access.
details: The agent runs in a read-only sandbox. The required BetterOffice MCP server is rooted at the task directory and is the only writer. Other document access tools are disabled. Code mode can call tools but has no file or network access. Server startup and required tools are checked before tasks run.

tasks.title: Fix a misspelled heading
tasks.prompt: In input.docx, the heading Sumary is misspelled. Change it to Summary. Edit the document directly, without tracked changes. Save the result as output.docx, leaving input.docx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Rename a project everywhere
tasks.prompt: In input.docx, replace every occurrence of the project name Atlas with Beacon, in the title, the body text, the list and the table. The match is case-sensitive, so leave the lowercase word atlas unchanged. Edit the document directly, without tracked changes. Save the result as output.docx, leaving input.docx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Correct a table value
tasks.prompt: In input.docx, correct the Budget table: the Actual amount for Supplies is 130, not 100, so the Actual total is 660, not 630. Edit the document directly, without tracked changes. Save the result as output.docx, leaving input.docx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Add a table row above the total
tasks.prompt: In input.docx, add a row to the Budget table directly above the Total row: Item Training, Owner Avery, Planned 80, Actual 75. Format it like the other expense rows, not like the bold Total row. Then update the Total row to Planned 700 and Actual 705. Edit the document directly, without tracked changes. Save the result as output.docx, leaving input.docx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Delete a table row
tasks.prompt: In input.docx, the Supplies line was cancelled. Delete its row from the Budget table and update the Total row to Planned 500 and Actual 530. Edit the document directly, without tracked changes. Save the result as output.docx, leaving input.docx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Promote a paragraph to a heading
tasks.prompt: In input.docx, make the paragraph Risks and mitigations a Heading 2, a subsection heading under Next steps, using the document's Heading 2 style. Keep its text. Edit the document directly, without tracked changes. Save the result as output.docx, leaving input.docx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Bold a phrase
tasks.prompt: In input.docx, in the paragraph that begins The pilot started, make only the phrase ten participants bold. Edit the document directly, without tracked changes. Save the result as output.docx, leaving input.docx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Insert a paragraph below a heading
tasks.prompt: In input.docx, insert a new paragraph directly below the heading Next steps with the text The steering group meets on 20 October. Use the normal body text style. Edit the document directly, without tracked changes. Save the result as output.docx, leaving input.docx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Delete a draft note
tasks.prompt: In input.docx, delete the paragraph that starts with Draft note. Edit the document directly, without tracked changes. Save the result as output.docx, leaving input.docx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Finalize a report
tasks.prompt: In input.docx, finalize the report: replace the placeholder [DATE] with 14 October 2026, delete the line that only says DRAFT, and make the first line, Pilot status report, a Heading 1. Edit the document directly, without tracked changes. Save the result as output.docx, leaving input.docx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Change a slide title
tasks.prompt: In input.pptx, change the title on slide 1 from Quarterly update to Quarterly results. Save the result as output.pptx, leaving input.pptx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Update a reported figure
tasks.prompt: In input.pptx, on slide 2 change Revenue: $1.2 million to Revenue: $1.5 million. Leave the margin and retention figures intact. Save the result as output.pptx, leaving input.pptx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Replace a bullet list
tasks.prompt: In input.pptx, replace the three bullets on slide 2, Next steps, with these three bullets in order: Finish the pilot; Collect feedback; Launch in October. Keep the existing bullet formatting. Save the result as output.pptx, leaving input.pptx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Rename a project in slide text
tasks.prompt: In input.pptx, replace Atlas with Beacon everywhere in the visible slide titles and bullets. Leave speaker notes as they are. Save the result as output.pptx, leaving input.pptx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Finalize two slide titles
tasks.prompt: In input.pptx, change slide 2 title Draft results to Results and slide 3 title Draft next steps to Next steps. Leave mentions of those phrases in bullets and speaker notes unchanged, and keep both slides in their current positions. Save the result as output.pptx, leaving input.pptx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Remove an appendix slide
tasks.prompt: In input.pptx, delete slide 3, titled Appendix. Keep the other slides in their current order. Save the result as output.pptx, leaving input.pptx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Reorder a presentation
tasks.prompt: In input.pptx, arrange the slides in this order by title: Overview, Agenda, Results, Next steps. Keep each slide's content and speaker notes attached to that slide. Save the result as output.pptx, leaving input.pptx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Write speaker notes
tasks.prompt: In input.pptx, replace the speaker notes on slide 2, Results, with exactly two paragraphs: Pause for questions after the chart. and Ask which metric needs a follow-up. Put each sentence in its own paragraph. Save the result as output.pptx, leaving input.pptx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Add a positioned text box
tasks.prompt: In input.pptx, add a text box on slide 1 containing Internal draft. Place its top-left corner 0.5 inches from the left edge and 5 inches from the top edge, with width 3 inches and height 0.5 inches. Use 18-point text in #666666. Save the result as output.pptx, leaving input.pptx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Insert a slide with bullets and notes
tasks.prompt: In input.pptx, insert a new slide immediately after slide 2, Agenda. Give it the title Pilot plan and three separate bullets in this order: Start with ten users; Collect feedback daily; Report results in two weeks. Add exactly this speaker note to the new slide: Keep the pilot to two weeks. Save the result as output.pptx, leaving input.pptx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Correct a budget amount
tasks.prompt: In input.xlsx, change the planned Supplies amount in Budget!B3 to 180. Keep the totals as formulas and update their calculated results. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Repair a total formula
tasks.prompt: In input.xlsx, the Actual total in Budget!C5 leaves out Travel. Replace it with =SUM(C2:C4) and update its calculated result. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Rename a product across sheets
tasks.prompt: In input.xlsx, replace every occurrence of the case-sensitive product name Trail Mix with Forest Mix on both Catalog and Orders. Keep the rest of each cell intact. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Format a header
tasks.prompt: In input.xlsx, make Sales!A1:C1 bold and give those three header cells a solid light blue fill, color #D9EAF7. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Sort an inventory table
tasks.prompt: In input.xlsx, sort Inventory!A2:C5 by Stock in column C, smallest to largest. Move each complete row together and leave the header in row 1. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Add a currency total row
tasks.prompt: In input.xlsx, add a total row on Sales at row 5: A5 should say Total, B5 should contain =SUM(B2:B4), and C5 should contain =SUM(C2:C4). Format B5:C5 as dollars with two decimal places and a thousands separator, using $#,##0.00, and save calculated results. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Insert a growth column
tasks.prompt: In input.xlsx, insert a column immediately after Revenue column C, moving the existing Status column to E. Name D1 Growth %. In D2:D4 use =(C2-B2)/B2, =(C3-B3)/B3, and =(C4-B4)/B4 respectively. Format D2:D4 as percentages with one decimal place, using 0.0%, and save calculated results. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Rename and reorder sheets
tasks.prompt: In input.xlsx, rename Forecast to Outlook. Arrange the tabs in this order: Actuals, Outlook, Assumptions. Keep the formulas on Assumptions working by changing its B2 reference to ='Outlook'!B2; keep all other formulas and values intact. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Build a linked budget summary
tasks.prompt: In input.xlsx, add an Expenses total row at row 5 with A5 Total, B5 =SUM(B2:B4), and C5 =SUM(C2:C4). On Summary, set B2 to ='Expenses'!B5, B3 to ='Expenses'!C5, and B4 to =B3-B2. Format Expenses!B5:C5 and Summary!B2:B4 as dollars using $#,##0.00 and save calculated results. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.

tasks.title: Prepare a quarterly report
tasks.prompt: In input.xlsx on Quarterly, insert Growth % in a new column D, moving Owner to E. Sort the three data rows by Q2 descending, keeping each owner with the product. Set D2:D4 to =(C2-B2)/B2, =(C3-B3)/B3, and =(C4-B4)/B4. Add row 5 with A5 Total, B5 =SUM(B2:B4), C5 =SUM(C2:C4), and D5 =(C5-B5)/B5. Use 0.0% in D2:D5 and $#,##0.00 in B5:C5. Make A1:E1 bold with solid #D9EAF7 fill. Save calculated results. Save the result as output.xlsx, leaving input.xlsx unchanged and preserving everything else.
